How I write prompts for my travel blog

Every post on this blog starts from the same three parts, written before I open the chat window.

  • System prompt: who the readers are, and that I want British spelling
  • Notes: what I saw, ate and paid on the trip, with the dates
  • Outline: the headings I want, in order

I check every price and opening time against my notes before the post goes out.
